title: Blue standing brazier

infobox.Crafting Materials: Bronze x5, Greydwarf eye x5, Fenris claw x3
infobox.Other Effect(s): Produces smoke, Removes the Cold Effect, Adds the Fire Effect, Rapidly removes the Wet Effect, Reduces Freezing Effect to Cold Effect

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Blue standing brazier is a light source that can be placed on any surface, and must be built within the range of a Forge.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text:
The Blue standing brazier has all the same functions as a Campfire and is a base structure.
Blue standing braziers are fueled with Greydwarf eyes. With 1/5 fuel, a Blue standing brazier will last for 5 hours and 33 minutes. At maximum capacity, a Blue standing brazier should burn for 27 hours and 47 minutes. It can be used for cooking, however, it does not fit easily like a Campfire does.
The Fire Effect for the Blue standing brazier extends for about 4–5 meters (Measured from the closest the player can stand without setting themselves on fire).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Destroying the Blue standing brazier with a Hammer will not yield back any Greydwarf eyes and will only return the 5 Bronze and 3 Fenris claws used for its construction. All Greydwarf eyes used as fuel and for the initial construction will not be dropped.
• Blue standing braziers found in Howling Caverns can be destroyed for up to 2 Coal and sometimes 1 Bronze.
• Blue standing braziers stop working if exposed to rainy weather without a roof.
